_meta.status: draft — field list from WS-C 360 plan (docs/rag/360/03 §1, 05 module 1) + board findings A5; not legally reviewed
rules: Unknown stays unknown: null or the value "not_sure" is never defaulted.
Exact revenue is never required; a band (or "not_sure") is enough for the MVP.
Only synthetic profiles are accepted in this build (synthetic: true).
requirement: required = needed for any obligation list; conditional = needed only when 'needed_when' holds; optional = improves answers.

emirate.question: Which emirate is your business licensed in?

jurisdiction_type.question: Is your licence from a mainland authority or a free zone?
jurisdiction_type.clarify: A designated zone is a special VAT category; if unsure choose free_zone and we will ask more.

licensing_authority.question: Which authority issued your licence (for example DET Dubai, a free-zone authority)?

legal_form.question: What is your business's legal form?

person_type.question: Is the business you yourself (a natural person) or a separate company (a juridical person)?

activities.question: What does your business do (pick from your licence activities)?

licence_issue_date.question: When was your licence first issued?

licence_expiry_date.question: When does your licence expire (date printed on the licence)?

financial_year_end.question: When does your financial year end (for example 12-31)?

revenue_band_last_12m.question: Roughly how much did the business sell in the last 12 months?

taxable_supplies_last_12m_aed.question: If you know it: total taxable sales in the last 12 months (AED).

expected_taxable_supplies_next_30d_aed.question: Expected taxable sales in the next 30 days (AED), if known.

taxable_expenses_last_12m_aed.question: Taxable expenses in the last 12 months (AED), if known.

vat_registration_status.question: Is the business registered for VAT?

ct_registration_status.question: Is the business registered for corporate tax?

has_employees.question: Do you employ anyone (other than yourself)?

keeps_accounting_records.question: Do you keep records of sales, expenses and receipts?

documents_available.question: Which documents do you already have ready?
